comparison.objective: Center a captive crossbar so its carrier can dock; candidate adjusts and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-886 tests constrained prismatic centering and carrier insertion; candidate tests recessed tool insertion, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-886 requires full docking, release, linkage consistency, and stable retention; candidate requires safe repeated impacts and no collar drift. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Both involve passive mechanisms, but centering-for-clearance does not test adjustable damping or tool-secured retention.
